summary.text: Sheila Klinker is a Democratic state representative who represents Indiana House District 27, has served since 1982, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. She is a former teacher and Purdue University outreach liaison.

paragraphs.text: Sheila Klinker's professional experience includes working as an outreach liaison with the Purdue University School of Education and as a teacher at Tecumseh Middle School, Miami Elementary School, Edgelea School and Klondike Elementary School.
Klinker assumed office in 1982 and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Education, Veterans Affairs and Public Safety, and Ways and Means committees.
